kind: physical properties only (material, surface, rigidity, edges); no function, no colour, no weight (size varies per participant). Drafted 2026-11-13 from the original renders; for review.

descriptions.shape_1: A smooth, rigid body of matte ceramic-like material, enclosed by a thin, hard metal ring; all edges are rounded.
descriptions.shape_2: Made of hard, smooth plastic with a matte finish; the thin rods are stiff and do not bend, and their ends are blunt.
descriptions.shape_3: A rigid core of dark, stone-like material with smooth, flat arms, plus a few frosted, glass-like translucent pieces; edges are slightly rounded.
descriptions.shape_10: A firm dome with a rough, sandy top and a smooth, glossy band, resting on soft, slightly flexible rubbery points.
descriptions.shape_11: Made of hard, dark, polished stone with faint cracks; the small curls on top are rigid; edges are crisp.
descriptions.shape_12: A rigid metal frame with smooth inset panels of glass-like and soft rubbery material; straight, firm edges.
descriptions.shape_13: A smooth, hard ceramic shell with two holes through it; the inner surfaces are glossy; all edges are rounded.
descriptions.shape_14: A solid block of smooth, polished stone wrapped around a lighter, slightly textured inner piece with an opening.
descriptions.shape_15: A smooth, firm glazed-ceramic body with a rough, textured top; the thin points are rigid with sharp tips.
descriptions.shape_16: Made of hard, smooth, matte plastic; the thin legs and arch are rigid; the top block is solid with rounded corners.
descriptions.shape_17: A soft, rubbery body with a thick raised rim and a bumpy, textured centre; it gives a little when pressed.
descriptions.shape_18: A flat piece of hard, smooth metal with curled edges, holding a soft, slightly squishy gel-like centre.
descriptions.shape_19: A firm dome of smooth, leathery material with hard, sharp points on top and a soft, fleshy underside.
descriptions.shape_20: Made of firm, matte clay-like material with a slightly rough surface; the legs and stubs are rigid with rounded tips.
descriptions.shape_21: A single solid piece of hard, smooth, matte clay-like material; rigid throughout, with rounded edges.
descriptions.shape_22: Stacked layers of hard, smooth glazed ceramic, with two rigid curved loops on the sides; rounded edges.
descriptions.shape_23: Made of firm, matte clay-like material with a slightly rough texture; rigid throughout, with rounded edges.
descriptions.shape_24: A single solid piece of hard, smooth, matte clay-like material with a hole through it; rigid, with rounded edges.
descriptions.shape_25: A rigid body of matte, unglazed clay-like material with a ribbed band around its middle; rounded edges.
descriptions.shape_26: A firm, rubbery body covered in short, hard points, with a soft, smooth inset framed by a metal rim.
descriptions.shape_27: Made of firm, matte clay-like material with a bumpy texture; the thin points are stiff with pointed tips.
descriptions.shape_28: A flat, firm clay-like body with curled edges and raised dots, around a smooth, slightly glossy centre; rounded edges.
descriptions.shape_29: A firm, matte clay-like body with a deep, smooth-walled opening, on short rigid legs, with small round knobs on thin stalks.
descriptions.shape_30: Made of firm, matte clay-like material, with a thick, rigid ring passing around the body; the thin stalks are stiff.
descriptions.shape_31: Stacked layers of firm, matte clay-like material with two rigid curved loops; short, stiff points on top.
descriptions.shape_32: Made of firm, matte clay-like material; the arch and legs are rigid, and the small knobs and curls are solid.
descriptions.shape_33: Made of firm, matte clay-like material with a solid block on top; the points and coil are rigid.
descriptions.shape_38: A single solid piece of hard, matte clay-like material with a hole through it; rigid, with rounded edges.
descriptions.shape_39: A single solid piece of hard, matte clay-like material with a square hole through its body; rigid, with rounded edges.
descriptions.shape_40: A single solid piece of hard, matte clay-like material with a curled top and a grid of small holes; rigid, with rounded edges.
